## Use case
What are you trying to build, and what's getting in the way? Describe the
problem first — not just a proposed API. It helps us find the right primitive.

## What you'd like
The capability or change you're proposing.

## Alternatives considered
Workarounds you've tried, or other approaches you weighed.

## Scope
- [ ] This is a framework concern (not specific to the hosted benmore.ai platform)
